_readme: NSE surveillance lists (ASM and GSM). Load them from the official CSV files you download from nseindia.com with: npm run surveillance:import -- asm path/to/asm.csv   (and gsm). The app shows nothing about surveillance until a list is loaded, and it always shows the list date.
source: NSE Additional Surveillance Measure (ASM) and Graded Surveillance Measure (GSM) lists
